title: Apple iPhone 16
description: The iPhone 16 is built for Apple Intelligence, the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data - not even Apple.

userReviews.text:
I have always been an android user. Due to security issues my husband and I both bought new iphones last week. Best buy does not carry more than 2 iphone covers- sad. We purchased the Geek squad support /yr but staff were very busy and preoccupied; they punched in the wrong language and had a hard time figuring out how to fix it. Iphone 16 does not have an instruction manual so transferring data manually was very complex and confusing, phone settings not user friendly, too many preloaded apps that have too many permissions allowed. I felt that being forced to get an Apple ID and the information was intrusive. Personal privacy and security of information is very important to me but so far this phone has asked for everything but a stool sample... No, I don't need to be tracked by location or have voice command help- I am not a lost child, I am an adult.
Auto correct is so annoying -it changes words and names it has no business changing- over and over... I have spent a week trying to learn and personalize it but alas, I may be sending it back. New phone has to be charged daily? is this normal? My android could go 3-4 days w/o charging. aggh. Question: Whose controlling who? Under the guise of 'helpful tools'.

After the rave reviews I read about this specific device, I decided to give it a chance. It is a very beautiful, quality device that without a case fits incredibly well in the hand, while with a case it feels like any other iPhone. Incredibly fast, with the screen being very good. Of course, anyone who is used to 120hz should better avoid it. The camera takes particularly good photos, and if you play a bit with the undertones, they become EPIC day and night. I won't even comment on the video. I got used to the capture button in 5-6 days and use it many times, but I could live without it. My only complaint is that the phone hasn't "settled" perfectly yet, with a few silly bugs that will be smoothed out in a little while (I bought it in October). Apps load instantaneously, with the 8gb ram the phone flies. The battery, classically iPhone, you charge it at night, with heavy use it will charge during the day as well. The speakers also impressed me with how good they are. Now, if someone has the 11, as I did, with a good battery, it's better not to upgrade. The differences are small for the average user of social media, camera, light gaming. And the iOS is much more "settled" on the 11, 0 bugs. Otherwise, wait until spring when Apple intelligence will come and generally until iOS "settles." For me, at the same price, it was worth much more than the 15 plus, but if it were convenient for me, I would go straight to the 15 pro. Conclusion: whoever looks to find flaws will find them (60hz screen, etc.), but generally a very powerful device that will last for years. Again, if 120hz is not an issue for you, I highly recommend it. Τέλη '26 και χρησιμοποιώ ακόμη την συσκευή. Η υγεία της μπαταρίας βρίσκεται στο 87% με 830 κύκλους και η διάρκεια της μίκρυνε αισθητά στο ios27. Κατά τα άλλα κανένα πρόβλημα απολύτως. Μόνο πρόβλημα που αντιμετώπισα ήταν με τις official θήκες apple που παρόλο που το κινητό τις φορούσε γρατζουνίστηκε σε μικρές πτώσεις.

My last phone, an i phone 6 was in my opinion far superior to the 16, I may get used to this new phone but currently I’m still struggling. For example swiping to turn off an App. doesn’t always work and I often have to switch the phone off and start again, yesterday it changed my wallpaper picture WHY ???
I’ve always had I phones, well for donkeys years but this is the worst, I only changed from the 6 because it was so full it wouldn’t operate properly and when I deleted stuff to get it operational for some reason it would fill up again overnight…with what I haven’t a clue.
